Name: Eat and Drink From Inventory
Author: Zamiell
Description:
Additionally, it automatically pauses the game once the consumption animation is completed and returns you to the same facing direction that you were before.

By default, the hotkey is bound to Q, but this can be changed through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (or by editing the "config.json" file).

(It also allows you to use warp totems and staircases in the same way.)

The source code for this mod is [url=https://github.com/Zamiell/stardew-valley-mods/tree/main/EatDrinkFromInventory]available on GitHub[/url].
